description: Looks up 1-10 DOIs or arXiv ids: does the paper exist, its title, authors, year and venue, how often it is cited, and whether it has been retracted. Pass the titles you cited to see if they match the real ones. Catches made-up references. No AI involved; if the lookup services are down you are not charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

ids.description: DOIs (10.xxxx/...), doi.org links or arXiv ids

titles.description: Titles you cited, in the same order as ids, to compare with the real ones

name: check_doi
title: Check papers by DOI or arXiv id
